witness.branch: Facing a green arrow over a proposed travel lane.
witness.quote: A downward-pointing green arrow means that a driver facing the signal may drive in any lane over which the green signal is shown.
witness.reason: The lane-signal travel cell directly supports the green-arrow permission once indication, placement and facing are established.
required_context: Establish highway status, official-device provenance, exact green downward-arrow indication and signal-to-lane mapping.
Establish that the driver faces the signal while it is shown.
Place a downward-pointing green arrow over an individual highway lane and map it to the proposed driving route.
Specify the proposed route and retain driver orientation, signal state and relevant lane geometry.
Supply highway status and official-device provenance.
The paired red-X provision is supplied in this request and should be assessed independently when its indication is present.
